title: Koe ga dasenai Shoujo wa “Kanojo ga Yasashisugiru” to Omotte iru
alternative_titles: A Girl Who Can't Speak Thinks "She Is Too Kind."
The Mute Girl and Her New Friend

A serialization about the story of a mute transfer girl who uses a sketchbook to talk to people, and a bullish classmate with a special ability who befriends her.
